source.receipt_transport: controlled Python 3.12 collection failure after read-only replay

buy_hold_same_universe_window.method: equal capital across current production 17; first available opening buy using native buy slippage and commission; terminal mark-to-market without forced terminal sale
buy_hold_same_universe_window.interpretation: Trade outperformed this matched Buy & Hold benchmark while experiencing a materially shallower maximum drawdown. This is a capability comparison, not an additive causal decomposition.

account_risk_budget_counterfactual.interpretation: In this frozen window AB5 bought about 1.39 percentage points of maximum-drawdown improvement at an opportunity cost of about 404.06 percentage points of total return and 356 additional internal sleeve fills. This does not identify the value of the rest of the risk stack.

winner_lifecycle.classification_rule: premature_major_winner if post-sale 60-session return >=20% or 120-session return >=30%; forward returns are descriptive and non-additive

buy_quality.interpretation: Opportunity discovery inside the current 17-symbol universe is not the leading diagnosed weakness; many entries precede durable advances.

next_research_direction.priority_1: winner lifecycle: distinguish protective exits from avoidable truncation and repeated exit/re-entry
next_research_direction.priority_2: AB5 risk-return efficiency: preserve risk-state/account continuity while testing lower intervention frequency or better winner protection under a preregistered contract
next_research_direction.priority_3: order consolidation only where it removes low-value churn; do not suppress high-value entries or hard-risk actions
next_research_direction.not_first_priority: broad opportunity-discovery expansion inside the current production 17, because entry forward-return diagnostics are already strong

limitations: Post-sale and post-buy forward returns are descriptive opportunity diagnostics. They overlap and capital is reused, so they must not be summed as portfolio alpha impact.
TradeRecord counts are internal sleeve fills. Date-symbol-side buckets are closer to nettable broker actions but are still not broker-order records.
The equal-capital Buy & Hold path is a matched capability benchmark, not a causal decomposition of risk protection because allocation and entry/exit paths differ.
The AB5 on/off comparison is the clean causal counterfactual in this study and isolates only the existing account-risk-budget mechanism; all other risk logic remains active.
The uquant comparison is structural unless both systems are replayed on a matched universe, window, capital and cost contract.
